observations.code_quote: store_skills = resolve_store_skills(team, actor_user or task.created_by, run_id=run_id)
observations.posthog_connection: Resolves store skills and stores them in the task run state before the sandbox agent re-reads the run, supplying the sandbox with the activating user's skills without requiring an extra request. This supports the sandbox's ability to use the user's configured skills immediately after a message or actor change.
